property_summary: Only the contract owner may change ownership: for any non-owner caller, transferOwnership must revert and c.owner() must remain the deployer; the mutant removes the onlyOwner check, so a non-owner's call succeeds and changes c.owner().
change_summary: Remove the _checkOwner() call so any caller can pass the onlyOwner modifier, letting non-owners call transferOwnership and change the owner.
